name: Nanjing Red Sun Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Red Sun Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sale, and technical servicing of green and environmentally friendly pesticides and intermediates for pesticides and pharmaceuticals in China and internationally. The company offers intermediates, including pyridine, 3-methylpyridine, 2,2'-bipyridine, 2,3-dichloropyridine, sodium trichloropyridinol, and ethyl chloride. It also provides herbicides, such as paraquat, dichlorvos dibromide, dichlorvos dichloride, and L-glufosinate; insecticides, including chlorantraniliprole, chlorpyrifos, imidacloprid, and pyrethroids; and bactericides, such as imazalil.
